verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a security and compliance platform with automation surfaces (an MCP server, service keys for agent automation, and Fieldwork AI evidence agents), so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, review workflows, or rollback for automations. Policy draft publishing and control review history are adjacent features about documents and controls, not automations, so they earn no credit.
